nodes.label: AMPM Website & App — Business Explanation for Developer
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Explains the AMPM business in simple language for the developer; the detailed AMPM Technical Specification holds the development requirements. Written so the developer confirms the business process before writing code.

nodes.label: AMPM (wedding planning and management business)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: The platform must support clients who only want hotel-discovery access as well as clients who hire AMPM to manage their entire wedding.

nodes.label: The Four Parts of the Platform (public website, client portal, team workspace, guest RSVP portal)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf

nodes.label: Public Website
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Explains AMPM, showcases selected work and services and lets people contact AMPM or request a demo; the complete private hotel database must not be publicly accessible.

nodes.label: Client Portal
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Private login area where clients see only information intended for them: shared hotel options, functions and plans, client-facing budget, vendor proposals, designs/documents/approvals and appropriate guest/RSVP information.

nodes.label: AMPM Team Workspace
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Internal system for enquiries, hotels, projects, functions, vendors, budgets, guests, tasks and execution; internal notes, vendor negotiations, profit margins and private operational information must never be visible to clients.

nodes.label: Guest RSVP Portal
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Guests receive a link to confirm attendance and provide travel/accommodation details; the AMPM team must also be able to contact guests and enter their information manually.

nodes.label: AMPM Business Process (Steps 1-10)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Enquiry -> introduction/demo -> optional hotel-discovery subscription -> hotel exploration -> optional hotel services -> wedding project if hired -> parallel activities -> vendor options -> manage and execute -> complete project.

nodes.label: Client Enquiry (Step 1: Instagram, ads, referrals, website; record contact, requirements, source)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf

nodes.label: Hotel-Discovery Subscription (Step 3)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Subscription price and exact terms still to be decided by AMPM; access activates after successful payment; buying hotel-discovery access does not mean the client has hired AMPM for complete wedding management.

nodes.label: Hotel Exploration (Step 4: location, venues/capacities, rooms, media, previous weddings, pricing/availability)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: The system should indicate whether prices and availability have been verified and when they were last checked.

nodes.label: Additional Hotel Services (Step 5: availability checks, price negotiation, site visits, contract review, booking assistance)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Treated according to the scope agreed with the client; separate from the discovery subscription.

nodes.label: Wedding Project (Step 6: agreed services, fees, dates, responsibilities, requirements)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf

nodes.label: Parallel Workflows (Step 7 / Rule 3)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Wedding planning does not follow one fixed sequence: hotel discussions, design, invitations, save-the-dates, vendor selection and RSVP planning may happen at the same time, so the platform must let these activities progress in parallel.

nodes.label: Vendor Options (Step 8: around 5-10 options per service based on budget and expectations)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Decorators, photographers/videographers, sound/lighting, artists, food, tents/props/effects; the client reviews options and proposals shared with them.

nodes.label: Wedding Management & Execution (Step 9: budget, design, invitations, vendors, production, menus, guest travel/accommodation, schedules, wedding-day management)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf

nodes.label: Project Completion (Step 10: finish tasks, record final costs and documents, close project)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf

nodes.label: Information the Platform Needs to Manage (clients/enquiries, hotels, projects, functions, vendors, budgets, guests/RSVP, tasks/approvals, documents)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Keep connected records; the same information should not need to be entered repeatedly when it can be reused safely.

nodes.label: Wedding Functions (mehendi, sangeet, ceremony, reception — each with own timing, venue, design, requirements)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf

nodes.label: Important Rules for Development (9 rules)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Different access per user; no compulsory fields from the start; parallel workflows; clear statuses; track important changes; verify changing information; protect guest information; do not invent business policies; keep client view separate from internal view.

nodes.label: Rule 1 — Different Users Need Different Access
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Clients must not see AMPM's internal notes, private negotiations, internal ratings, profit margins or confidential operational information.

nodes.label: Rule 2 — Do Not Make Every Field Compulsory
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: A client who only wants hotel information should not have to fill out all the details required for full wedding management.

nodes.label: Rule 4 — Show Clear Statuses (pending, in progress, awaiting approval, confirmed, completed)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf

nodes.label: Rule 5 — Track Important Changes (budget, approvals, payments, contracts: who and when)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf

nodes.label: Rule 6 — Verify Changing Information
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Hotel prices, availability and vendor availability can change; the system must make the verification status clear.

nodes.label: Rule 7 — Protect Guest Information
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: Collect only information needed for the event; identity documents should not be compulsory by default and, if genuinely required, access must be restricted.

nodes.label: Rule 8 — Do Not Invent Business Policies
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: AMPM must confirm subscription prices, service fees, refund terms and payment rules before they are implemented.

nodes.label: Rule 9 — Keep the Client View Separate from the Internal View
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: The team manages information internally and shares only the appropriate client-facing information.

nodes.label: Main Screens Required (website, client portal, team workspace, guest RSVP portal)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: The exact screen structure should be reviewed and approved by AMPM before development begins.

nodes.label: What the Developer Should Do First (read brief + technical specification, wireframes, database structure, permissions table, technology recommendation, phases and cost, present for approval)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf

nodes.label: Decisions Still to Be Confirmed by AMPM (subscription price/duration/inclusions, cancellation and refund terms, hotel service fees, management fees and payment stages, release scope, roles and data-access rules)
nodes.source_file: reference_docs/AMPM Website & App —  Business Explanation for Developer.pdf
nodes.rationale: These must not be assumed by the developer; if any requirement is unclear, ask AMPM before deciding how it should work.
